info.description: High-performance BFF for Omsu university schedule.
info.title: Omsu Schedule Mirror API

get.description: Get all registered webhook subscribers

post.description: Register a new webhook subscriber or update existing by URL (idempotent)

put.description: Create or update a webhook subscriber by URL (idempotent)

get.description: Get all failed webhook deliveries (dead-letter queue)

delete.description: Remove a webhook subscriber by ID

patch.description: Update an existing webhook subscriber by ID

get.description: Returns a list of all auditories and buildings.
Returns buildings and the number of known rooms.
get.summary: List buildings that have an auditory map

get.description: Returns free and busy rooms for one pair based on the cached occupancy snapshot.
get.summary: Get free rooms for a building and pair

get.description: Returns all known rooms with occupied pairs. Data is a cached snapshot, not live.
get.summary: Get room occupancy for a building and day

get.description: Returns a single auditory by its ID.
Returns a filterable, paginated feed of schedule changes. Omit entity filters for all entities.

parameters.description: RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD lower bound by created_at
parameters.name: since

get.description: Returns recent schedule changes for a group, tutor, or auditory.
Returns a list of all study groups.
Returns a single group by its ID.
Returns service uptime and cache statistics.
Returns recent health incidents for the upstream service.

patch.description: Partially updates subscription preferences for an entity. Omitted fields keep their values.

get.description: Returns current notification preferences for a specific subscription.
Returns the schedule for a specific auditory. Lazy-fetches if not in cache.

parameters.description: Week start date in YYYY-MM-DD format
parameters.name: week_start

get.description: Returns the schedule for an auditory in .ics format. If ICAL_ACCESS_TOKEN is configured, pass it as the token query parameter.
Returns the schedule for a specific group. Lazy-fetches if not in cache.

parameters.description: Week start date in YYYY-MM-DD format
parameters.name: week_start

get.description: Returns the schedule for a group in .ics format. If ICAL_ACCESS_TOKEN is configured, pass it as the token query parameter.
Returns all subgroup numbers used in the cached group schedule (all weeks).
Returns the schedule for a specific tutor. Lazy-fetches if not in cache.

parameters.description: Week start date in YYYY-MM-DD format
parameters.name: week_start

get.description: Returns the schedule for a tutor in .ics format. If ICAL_ACCESS_TOKEN is configured, pass it as the token query parameter.
Returns the schedule for a specific day. Loads the whole week from cache if needed.
Token and substring search across groups, tutors and rooms. Understands "4-112", "112", "4 корпус 112" and "корпус 4".

parameters.description: Filter type: group, tutor, auditory, all
parameters.name: type

get.description: Returns a small HTML page with Open Graph metadata for Telegram/other link previews and a client-side redirect to today/week.
Returns all subscriptions belonging to the FCM token from X-FCM-Token.
Returns the last synchronization timestamps for dictionaries and schedules.

post.description: Forces a background synchronization of dictionaries and active schedules. (Admin only)

get.description: Returns a list of all teachers.
Returns a single teacher by their ID.

post.description: Removes a notification subscription for a group, tutor, or auditory.

api.subscribeRequest.description: Creates or updates a notification subscription for a group, tutor, or auditory.
